# Ali Auto

> Auto repair & brakes based in Pflugerville, Texas. Ali Auto on FM 685 is the Pflugerville shop people call when nobody else can fit them in. Brakes, electrical, oil changes and dash lights, done fast by Ali, Mohand and the crew.

- Phone: (512) 291-3607
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Service area: Pflugerville, Hutto, Round Rock, Manor, Austin
- Google rating: 4.4 from 48 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/ali-auto/quote.html
- Book a drop-off: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/ali-auto/book.html

## Services
- Brakes: Pads, rotors and brake service, a favourite with reviewers.
- Electrical & dash lights: Electrical faults, no-starts and warning lights, diagnosed fast.
- Oil changes & tires: Quick maintenance so the bigger stuff never happens.
- Transmission & drivetrain: Shifters, clutches and drivetrain work, including manuals.
- Dealer & fleet work: Repeat work for local car lots and people with more than one car.

## About
Ali Auto is Ali's shop on FM 685, and reviewers name Mohand and Mohammad too. One customer has sent cars there for nearly five years; a local dealership has used them since the day it opened. The theme in the reviews is speed: cars taken in at 4 PM on a Saturday and fixed by 6, crews staying late so someone could get to work the next day.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Are you open on Saturday?
  A: Yes, 10 AM to 6 PM. Weekdays you're open until 7 PM.
- Q: Can I bring my own parts?
  A: Reviewers say Ali has installed parts they brought from the parts store. Call to confirm for your job.
- Q: Do you work on trucks?
  A: Yes, including electrical diagnosis and repairs on pickups.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 19903 FM 685, Unit D, in Pflugerville.
